plot: At breakfast the dinner table starts stomping toward the open basement stairs with the bros on top; everyone blames grumpy Old Hissy because the table lurches when he whistles, but even under Lolly's tea cozy it keeps walking, until Crispy finds Zeek's Anti-Wobble Boots on the legs, which walk toward the loudest sound, and the loudest thing is screaming Pim; Hissy whistles the longest note in Table Land from the window to march the table back, and Zeek admits the spare boots are on the fridge.

script.title: Why Is the Breakfast Table Walking Away

beats.say: AAAAH! The table moved! The whole breakfast table just MOVED!
Thump. The dinner table takes one giant step across the kitchen.
Hold on to something! Preferably something that isn't walking!
Odd. I fixed that wobbly table leg last night. Yawn. Tiny project.
Under the table, something blinks blue. Nobody looks down.
Ssssilence! Some of us are trying to steep in peace!
Good morning, Mr. Hissy! So lovely of you to join our breakfast!
I came for quiet tea. Instead I get a hiking table.
It's walking to the b-b-basement stairs! I can see the dark!
Thump. Another step. The basement door creaks wide open.
Five steps to the stairs. Then breakfast goes down. With us.
Somebody is steering this table. And I think I know who.
Ssssstop staring at me! You're making me BOIL!
Hissy whistles. The table stomps two big steps toward the stairs.
He whistled and it walked! Every time! It's Mr. Hissy!
Me? I'm a kettle! I have no legs! Barely a lid!
Statistically, the grumpiest object at breakfast is usually guilty.
Then we cover the kettle. No whistle, no walking. Easy.
Lolly knits a pink tea cozy at frightening speed.
It has little hearts on it. Hold still, sweetie. Or else.
Mmmf. This is humiliating. And far too warm.
Quiet kettle, quiet table. Breakfast is saved, team.
A toast crumb drops from the ceiling. It lands on Pim's head.
AAAAAH! Something touched me! It's in my bandage!
The biggest step yet. One table leg now hangs over the stairs.
One more step and we tumble into the basement! All of us!
I'm too young to live in a basement! It smells like socks!
Mmmf! Covered! Silent! Still walking! Still not me!
He's right. Let me look where nobody looks. Underneath.
Crispy leans over the edge. Tiny blue boots blink on every leg.
Zeek. Why does our table wear boots?
Ah. My Anti-Wobble Boots. They walk toward the loudest sound.
So the table never wobbles away from a party. Brilliant, right?
Zeek. Sweetie. Darling. Genius. We're about to FALL!
But Hissy is covered. So who's the loudest thing here now?
Why is everyone looking at me? I'm a quiet little b-bean!
You screamed at breakfast. Thump. You screamed at a crumb. Thump.
So the table is walking toward... ME? AAAH! Oh no. Sorry!
Thump. Two legs over the stairs. Plates slide off the edge.
Get this sock off me. I'll be the loudest thing here.
Old Hissy waddles to the far end, by the sunny window.
The longest whistle in Table Land. The table marches back.
Mr. Hissy, you saved us! Can I hug you? You're very hot.
Don't thank me. Thank my lungs. Then go away.
Thank you, Mr. Hissy. That was my quietest thank you ever.
Good kettle. Loud kettle. Still grumpy kettle.
Funny thing. I put the spare boots on the fridge.
The FRIDGE?! AAAAAH!

long.title: Why Is the Breakfast Table Walking Away? 😳
long.description: In the middle of breakfast, the table starts stomping toward the basement stairs with the Dough Bros on top. Everyone blames grumpy Old Hissy… but covering the kettle doesn't stop it. Who do YOU think is making it walk? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy
